title: Banner Band and Bunk's trip to Texas
summary: After a mostly muttered stretch, she recalls the Banner Band and that Bunk left on Labor Day for Texas; she followed but disliked Texas and they returned to Lake Charles.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters

Yeah, Funny. No, he was in New Iberia. That was with the band in New Iberia. The Banner Band or something. Yeah. That was the old Banner Band and they called it Colton Roy. Lately they called it Colton Roy.

I think it's still going. I don't know. And then after that, he stayed with that band about a year and a half. And he went to Texas on a Labor Day. They went and played in Texas that Labor Day and he didn't come back.
Is that before you were married?

Yeah. And he didn't come back so he sent me over there. And we stayed in Texas about three or four months because I didn't like Texas. And he was going out at night and I was in the house by myself and I was afraid of the stones and things so he decided to come back to Lake Charles. So he came back to Lake Charles but he wasn't playing with nobody then.
